# Joseph

- **Family:** [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) (relative), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Joseph is notable for his physical appearance, specifically wearing a distinct coat of many colors. This colorful garment is the defining feature associated with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)_

## Personality

Joseph is naturally meek, inoffensive, and pacific, possessing a sociable disposition. Despite his peaceful nature, he is capable of fighting well when the occasion demands it.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P57](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0057), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063)_

## History

Joseph was given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by his original owner, a dear friend of hers who was moving to [Vancouver](../codex/places.md#vancouver) and could not take him along. Named Joseph because his multi-colored coat recalled a coat of many colors, he was brought to Patty's Place when [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) moved in as chaperone. Upon arrival, he was repeatedly attacked by the resident stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), though the two eventually resolved their conflicts and became close friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P3](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0003), [v3 ch.Relationships P7](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P9](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0009), [v3 ch.Relationships P15](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0015), [v3 ch.Relationships P16](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0016), +344 more_

## Relationships

### [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barbara-shaw--joseph.md)

[Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) is Joseph's niece, making Joseph her uncle.

- Relative of — uncle  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) first met when Joseph arrived at Patty's Place with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), prompting [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) to initiate repeated battles with him. After these early fights, the two cats settled their differences and became close, sworn friends. They eventually reached a peaceful bond, even sharing the same cushion to sleep on.

- Friend of — sworn friends who sleep on the same cushion (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--uncle-jim.md)

Joseph is the nephew of Captain Jim, who is also known as [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md). Joseph spends time with his uncle at the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse, including celebrating New Year's Eve alongside Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their friends.

- Relative of — nephew (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007)</sub>
